data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word 'frisor', meaning 'free man'. In Scotland, Frazier was a nickname for those who lived near a water mill or near a forest. The name Frazier carries the meaning “Free man” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Frazier usually hope their child will grow to embody free man and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Frazier total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

data.cultural_impact: The name Frazier has its roots in Old English and was used to describe someone who was free, or lawfully permitted to possess their own land and property. This implies a sense of independence and self-sufficiency. Over time, the name came to be associated with strength, courage, and achievement.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Frazier can be interpreted as a reminder of the freedom that we have in Christ. As believers, we are no longer bound by the laws of sin and death but have been set free to live a life that is fully surrendered to God. The name Frazier can serve as a daily reminder to put our trust and faith in God, who has granted us the ultimate freedom - the freedom to be children of God.
